source: 上外版选择性必修第二册 Unit 1 Grammar in Use:-ing/-ed forms used as predicatives。-ing/-ed 形式跟在 be/seem/get/look/become/feel/remain 等系动词后作表语，说明主语的性质或状态。句子地道、答案唯一。答案位由 _balance 打散。

points.point: -ing 形式作表语(说明事物的性质/命名活动)
points.overview: -ing 形式跟在 be/seem/sound/look 等系动词后作表语：①说明主语(事物/想法)令人产生某种感受，如 The findings were amazing；②在 'one's job/dream/task is + V-ing' 中说明所从事的活动，如 His job is studying animals。

points.point: -ed 形式作表语(说明人的感受/事物的状态)
points.overview: -ed 形式跟在 be/feel/seem/get/look/remain 等系动词后作表语，说明主语(多为人)的感受或事物所处的被动状态，如 The scientists were amazed；All these mysteries remain unsolved。
判断用 -ing 还是 -ed 作表语：主语是引起感受的事物→用 -ing(exciting)；主语是产生感受的人→用 -ed(excited)。

questions.stem: The results of the experiment were really ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 results 是引起感受的事物，用 -ing 形式作表语。

questions.stem: To young students, the idea of space travel sounds truly ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 idea 是事物，令人着迷，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: The professor's lecture on viruses was very ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 lecture 是事物，给人启发，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: The new discovery about DNA seemed quite ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 discovery 是事物，令人惊讶，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: For many people, the plan to land on Mars is ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 plan 是事物，令人激动，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: The strange data we collected last night looked rather ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 data 是事物，令人困惑，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: The story of the female scientist was deeply ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 story 是事物，感人，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: Watching the rocket take off was absolutely ____.
questions.explanation: 主语(动名词短语)是事物，令人激动，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: The result of his patent application was ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 result 是事物，令人失望，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: The way she never gave up is truly ____.
questions.explanation: 主语(the way 从句)是事物，给人鼓舞，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: The science fair this year was very ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 science fair 是事物，有趣，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: The strange noise from the old machine was a little ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 noise 是事物，令人担心，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: Her dream job is ____ new planets in deep space.
questions.explanation: 'job is + V-ing' 用 -ing 形式作表语，说明所从事的活动。

questions.stem: One key part of his work is ____ seeds for the national seed bank.
questions.explanation: 'part of work is + V-ing'，用 -ing 形式说明活动。

questions.stem: A biologist's daily task is ____ living things very closely.
questions.explanation: 'task is + V-ing'，用 -ing 形式作表语。

questions.stem: My goal this year is ____ how viruses spread among plants.
questions.explanation: 'goal is + V-ing'，用 -ing 形式说明活动。

questions.stem: His real passion is ____ machines that can help sick people.
questions.explanation: 'passion is + V-ing'，用 -ing 形式作表语。

questions.stem: The team's main duty is ____ the rare seeds for the future.
questions.explanation: 'duty is + V-ing'，用 -ing 形式说明活动。

questions.stem: Her main job on the team is ____ how the animal reacts in space.
questions.explanation: 'job is + V-ing'，用 -ing 形式作表语。

questions.stem: A good scientist's habit is ____ every result with great care.
questions.explanation: 'habit is + V-ing'，用 -ing 形式说明活动。

questions.stem: When the monkeys survived, the scientists were ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 scientists 是产生感受的人，用 -ed 形式作表语。

questions.stem: Hawking felt ____ when he first learned of his illness.
questions.explanation: 主语 Hawking 是人，感到害怕，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: The students were ____ at the news of the science prize.
questions.explanation: 主语 students 是人，感到激动，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: Professor Chen looked ____ at the failed results.
questions.explanation: 主语 Professor Chen 是人，感到失望，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: Franklin's parents seemed ____ about her choice at first.
questions.explanation: 主语 parents 是人，感到担心，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: We were all ____ by her courage in the face of hardship.
questions.explanation: 主语 we 是人，受到鼓舞，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: The young researcher felt ____ when the data made no sense.
questions.explanation: 主语 researcher 是人，感到困惑，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: Everyone in the lab was ____ with the final result.
questions.explanation: 主语 everyone 是人，感到满意，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: The visitors were deeply ____ by the scientist's life story.
questions.explanation: 主语 visitors 是人，被打动，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: She became ____ in biology when she was only fifteen.
questions.explanation: 主语 she 是人，对生物学感兴趣，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: The whole class was ____ to hear that the animals survived in space.
questions.explanation: 主语 class(指人)是产生感受的一方，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: After the long climb, Zhong's team felt completely ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 team(指人)感到精疲力竭，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: He was ____ by the warm support of his fellow scientists.
questions.explanation: 主语 he 是人，被感动，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: The children looked ____ during the whole science show.
questions.explanation: 主语 children 是人，被吸引，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: Many girls feel ____ to study science by Franklin's example.
questions.explanation: 主语 girls 是人，受到鼓励，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: For many years, the mystery of DNA remained ____.
questions.explanation: remain 后用 -ed 形式作表语，说明谜团'未被解开'的状态。

questions.stem: Zhong Yang was completely ____ to his work in Tibet.
questions.explanation: be devoted to 用 -ed 形式作表语，表示'专注于'。

questions.stem: The biologists were ____ to find the old seeds still alive.
questions.explanation: 主语 biologists 是人，感到高兴，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: Her important work went ____ for many years.
questions.explanation: go 后用 -ed 形式作表语，表示'未被注意'的状态。

questions.stem: The audience was ____ by the documentary about Franklin.
questions.explanation: 主语 audience 是人，被打动，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: The experiment was ____, so everyone wanted to try it themselves.
questions.explanation: 主语 experiment 是事物，令人激动，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: After the long test, the students felt ____ and went home to rest.
questions.explanation: 主语 students 是人，感到疲惫，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: The lecture about black holes was ____ from start to finish.
questions.explanation: 主语 lecture 是事物，令人着迷，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: The professor was ____ by the strange results on the screen.
questions.explanation: 主语 professor 是人，感到困惑，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: The news about the Nobel Prize was ____ to all of us.
questions.explanation: 主语 news 是事物，令人惊讶，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: We were ____ to hear how she never gave up on her dream.
questions.explanation: 主语 we 是人，受到鼓舞，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: Collecting seeds at high altitude is ____ work for the team.
questions.explanation: 修饰 work(事物)、说明其令人劳累，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: The young girl was very ____ in how plants grow.
questions.explanation: 主语 girl 是人，感兴趣，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: The final result of the long study was rather ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 result 是事物，令人失望，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: Franklin felt ____ when others took the credit for her work.
questions.explanation: 主语 Franklin 是人，感到气馁，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: The scientist's life story is truly ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 story 是事物，感人，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: The whole team looked ____ after the long journey to the mountains.
questions.explanation: 主语 team(指人)感到精疲力竭，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: The idea of one day living on Mars sounds ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 idea 是事物，令人惊叹，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: The children were ____ by the loud noise from the rocket.
questions.explanation: 主语 children 是人，感到害怕，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: Her speech about female scientists was very ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 speech 是事物，给人鼓舞，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: Everyone was ____ with the success of the experiment.
questions.explanation: 主语 everyone 是人，感到高兴，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: The data from the spaceship looked ____ at first.
questions.explanation: 主语 data 是事物，令人困惑，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: The students seemed ____ during the long, dull lecture.
questions.explanation: 主语 students 是人，感到无聊，用 -ed 形式。

questions.stem: Watching the rare seeds finally grow was deeply ____.
questions.explanation: 主语(动名词短语)是事物，令人有收获感，用 -ing 形式。

questions.stem: The biologist was ____ to see her work help so many people.
questions.explanation: 主语 biologist 是人，感到欣喜，用 -ed 形式。
